content.text: Historical live-action, same Chinese military clerk and same tent as the first frame. One continuous eye-level medium close-up. Start talking immediately, calmly and briskly, looking just beside camera: “李严交出此次粮运调度职责，受处分，仍须配合查问。” Only this clerk speaks. Keep the camera on his face and upper torso for all eight seconds. His hands remain resting below frame; no picking up or opening documents. A gentle push in, never tilt toward the desk. Same face, hat, beard, black robe, natural daylight. No text, subtitles, captions, floating panels, title cards, watermarks or readable document inserts. No extra people. Natural Chinese speech and quiet tent ambience only; no music.
